task_completion.description: A continuous side corridor and three distinct private sleeper suites are partitioned within the carriage shell.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D plan view should show a long wall running the length of the carriage to create a corridor, with three enclosed rooms (suites) adjacent to it.

task_completion.description: Each of the three sleeper suites contains an enclosed bathroom area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Within each of the three suite footprints, there must be additional internal walls creating a smaller separate room for the bathroom.

task_completion.description: At least six doors are installed: three between the corridor and suites, and three between suites and bathrooms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D plan or 3D view must show door icons or models connecting the corridor to each suite and each suite to its respective bathroom.

task_completion.description: Each suite has a bed/sleeper-sofa and storage; each bathroom has a toilet and sink.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D view or furniture list should show 3 beds/sofas, 3 storage units (wardrobes/chests), 3 toilets, and 3 sinks distributed across the three suites/bathrooms.

task_completion.description: A rear observation lounge is furnished with at least four seating items and a bar or table.
task_completion.visual_evidence: One end of the carriage (the lounge) must contain at least 4 chairs/armchairs and a table or bar counter object.

task_completion.description: At least two dimension lines document the walking clearance of the side corridor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D plan view must show at least two dimension line annotations (lines with numerical values) measuring the width of the corridor.
The Sweet Home 3D interface should show a 'Save' action in the menu/toolbar or a 'Save' dialog box, and the file name 'train_carriage_starter.sh3d' (or similar) in the title bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D drawing area, and the 3D view, rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The layout is a result of manual placement, not a pre-loaded completed file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the progression of walls being drawn and furniture being added one by one.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Sweet Home 3D software environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Sweet Home 3D window frame, menus (File, Edit, Furniture), and the specific 4-pane layout (catalog, list, 2D, 3D) must be visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The starter file is 'train_carriage_starter.sh3d'. The carriage shell is 2500x350 cm. The agent must achieve a score of 70/100 to pass. The task requires exactly three suites, each with a bathroom, plus a lounge. A minimum of 6 doors is strictly required.
